content:
josh-support: hey @maria-customer — following up on INV-8724, our automated VAT check returned a failure and billing won't apply reverse-charge. Can you confirm the exact VAT/Tax ID you submitted?

maria-customer: hi, sent GB999888777 in the portal and attached a resale_certificate_2026.pdf yesterday. says 'eligible for reverse charge' on our side.

tax-bot: Automated VAT validation attempt: VIES query for GB999888777 -> STATUS: TIMEOUT (503) at 2026-03-16T09:12Z. No match found in fallback registry.

josh-support: thanks. portal shows file uploaded but our extractor flagged it as "image/jpeg" (scan) and OCR confidence low. I can't manually approve without a readable scan + legal entity match.

pablo-billing: we also need a PO on file to release the invoice for reverse-charge. customer message didn't include a PO number. @maria-customer can you add PO-1423 to the invoice? Without PO our AR process blocks manual adjustments.

maria-customer: ok adding PO now. one sec.

anna-finance: small process note — for EU reverse-charge we require one of: valid VIES match OR a signed resale certificate with company legal name and VAT ID AND company registration number. If VIES is down (timeouts) we can accept the signed cert but finance needs the signer name + date.

josh-support: repro steps for ops if VIES keeps timing out: 1) curl our internal tax service: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/tax/validate -d '{"vat_id":"GB999888777","country":"GB"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
2) check logs on tax-connector pod: `kubectl logs tax-connector-*** -c validator` 3) confirm we hit VIES or fallback registry. Observed response: `{"status":"timeout","code":503,"vies_response":null}`

sam-ops: added to my queue. initial hypothesis: third-party VIES endpoint intermittent in eu-west-1. I can route validation through backup-cache node that has recent snapshots of VIES for 24h, but that requires compliance sign-off to accept cached attestations.

anna-finance: approve cached attestations only if customer provides signed resale cert and PO. If both present, finance will manually set `reverse_charge=true` on the invoice.

pablo-billing: to speed this, @maria-customer please upload a higher-res PDF of the certificate, include the company registration number, and post the PO number here. If uploads still OCR-fail, you can email proof to billing@redwood.com and we'll attach it manually.

maria-customer: uploaded new PDF (resale_cert_V2.pdf) and added PO-1423. emailed billing@ as well.

josh-support: I can see the new file, OCR confidence improved to 87% and legal name matches our account record (Lumina Labs Ltd). I'll kick manual approval to finance.

tax-bot: Audit note: manual VAT override requested by josh-support for INV-8724 referencing PO-1423. Reason: VIES timeout, valid resale cert on file.

anna-finance: received. I'll review and, pending compliance sign-off, set reverse_charge=true and update invoice status to "net". Expect update within 2 business days. Please tell customer the ETA.

maria-customer: thanks everyone. appreciate the help — small ask: will there be any charge or delay because of this?

pablo-billing: once reverse-charge is applied, the invoice will be net (no VAT charged) and payment terms unchanged. No extra fees from our side.

sam-ops: ops note for follow-up: open ticket with tax-provider vendor to investigate repeat VIES timeouts in eu-west-1; link internal ticket #TAX-409.

josh-support: closing loop here — I'll post final status to this thread when finance confirms. If anyone needs the raw OCR output or logs for the validation call, DM me. :thumbsup:
